question: What rate would I get on a 500k loan with a 20% deposit?
reply:
A 20% deposit means an LVR of 80%, which falls in the "LVR 60.01% to 80%" band.

From the page on examplelender.com.au (read 13 Oct 2026, 12:00 pm Perth time), the Example Basic Home Loan variable rate for that band is:

Interest rate: 6.14% p.a.
Comparison rate: 6.17% p.a.
Monthly fee: $0

Note: this is the variable rate table only; I haven't checked it against the fixed rate options above, which may be worth comparing for a $500k loan.
